name: TORRES
bio: Fernando Torres was a deadly young striker in 2006, captaining Atlético Madrid with exceptional speed and finishing before announcing himself on the world stage with 3 goals for Spain at the 2006 FIFA World Cup.

name: DE GEA
bio: David De Gea's 2017-18 season with Manchester United cemented him as arguably the world's best goalkeeper at the time. He won the Premier League Golden Glove with 18 clean sheets. His most legendary performance came against Arsenal, where he made a joint-Premier League record 14 miraculous saves in a single match, showcasing his superhuman reflexes and shot-stopping ability.

name: OTAMENDI
bio: Nicolás Otamendi was a defensive titan during Manchester City's record-breaking 100-point 'Centurions' 2017-18 season. Beyond his aggressive tackling and incredible aerial dominance, he surprisingly contributed 4 crucial Premier League goals, making him the top-scoring center-back in the league and earning a well-deserved spot in the PFA Team of the Year.

name: DAVID LUIZ
bio: Returning to Chelsea for the 2016-17 season, David Luiz transformed into the linchpin of Antonio Conte's 3-4-3 formation. His exceptional ball-playing ability, long-range passing, and newfound defensive maturity were crucial in Chelsea dominating the Premier League and winning the title, earning him a place in the PFA Team of the Year.

name: VOZINHA
bio: Vozinha has established himself as a true legendary figure for the Cape Verde national team. In 2026, his immense experience, reflexes, and leadership from the back continue to make him a fan favorite. His crucial saves in major international tournaments and AFCON qualifiers have cemented his legacy as a national icon.

name: BLIND
bio: Daley Blind was an elite orchestrator from the back during Ajax's historic 2018-19 season. Operating as a center-back, his visionary passing, tactical intelligence, and composure were key in Ajax winning the Dutch domestic double and reaching the UEFA Champions League semi-finals, memorably dominating against Real Madrid and Juventus.

name: SHAQIRI
bio: Xherdan Shaqiri was an ultimate game-changer for Liverpool during their 2018-19 Champions League-winning campaign. Known for his magical left foot, he memorably scored a match-winning brace against Manchester United and provided a brilliant, precise cross for Wijnaldum in the legendary 4-0 comeback victory against Barcelona at Anfield.

name: HERRERA
bio: Ander Herrera was the tactical engine and beating heart of Manchester United in the 2016-17 season. His relentless work rate, precise tackling, and brilliant man-marking abilities earned him the Sir Matt Busby Player of the Year award as he played a huge role in United winning both the UEFA Europa League and the League Cup.

name: AUBAMEYANG
bio: The 2016-17 season was nothing short of spectacular for Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang at Borussia Dortmund. He won the Bundesliga Top Scorer award (Torjägerkanone) by netting a staggering 31 goals in just 32 league matches. His blistering pace and clinical finishing were unstoppable, ultimately leading BVB to a DFB-Pokal trophy.

name: DYBALA
bio: Paulo Dybala was the absolute star of Italian football in the 2019-20 season. 'La Joya' won the prestigious Serie A MVP award, guiding Juventus to another Scudetto with 11 goals and 11 assists in the league. His magical dribbling, link-up play, and spectacular long-range curling goals defined a brilliant peak in his career.

name: ALARCÓN
bio: Isco was magical during Real Madrid's historic 2016-17 double-winning campaign, securing both La Liga and the UEFA Champions League. His exquisite close control, press-resistance, and creativity in the diamond midfield unlocked stubborn defenses, most notably scoring a crucial goal away against Atlético Madrid in the Champions League semi-finals.

name: ZIYECH
bio: Hakim Ziyech was the creative heartbeat of Ajax's sensational run to the UEFA Champions League semi-finals in the 2018-19 season. Nicknamed the 'Wizard of Boz', his pinpoint long-range passing, deadly left-foot crosses, and crucial goals against elite opponents earned him global acclaim and dominance in Dutch football.

name: INSIGNE
bio: Lorenzo Insigne had a phenomenal 2020-21 campaign for Napoli, scoring 19 Serie A goals from the left wing, and followed it up by being a pivotal player in Italy's triumphant UEFA Euro 2020 championship run, where his trademark curling strikes and relentless creativity inspired the Azzurri to glory.

name: JOÃO PEDRO
bio: João Pedro had an outstanding 2025-26 campaign for Brighton, establishing himself as a top-tier forward. Netting 22 goals across all competitions, his lethal finishing, agility, and ability to shoot perfectly with both feet were crucial for his club. This Season Pass Player card is introduced to honor his incredible goal-scoring form, dynamic presence in the attacking third, and remarkable evolution as one of the Premier League's most dangerous attackers.
